License Detector — test fixtures

One page per license-declaration convention the extension's detector recognizes (see the project's top-level README's "How detection works" section for the full explanation). Load the extension unpacked, open each page below, and check the popup against the noted expected result.

See README.md in this directory for how to serve these pages and why a local server (or the file-access permission) is required.

Certain — explicit SPDX tag (this extension's own addition, not part of GNU/LibreJS's convention)

spdx-inline.html
Inline script, SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT. Expected: MIT, no "guess" note.
spdx-external.html
External script, SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0. Expected: Apache-2.0, no "guess" note.

Guessed — GNU's @license/@licstart/ @licend convention

license-tag-standalone-external.html
A bare // @license <magnet-link> <name> / // @license-end tag, no @licstart wrapper — exactly how Google's prettify.js is tagged as loaded by GNU's own librejs pages (this was completely undetected, "Missing", before the fix). Expected: Apache-2.0, marked "best guess".
license-tag-standalone-inline.html
Same standalone-tag convention, embedded directly in an inline script instead of an external one. Expected: GPL-2.0-or-later, marked "best guess".
license-tag-in-licstart.html
The @license tag embedded inside a verbose @licstart/@licend block. Expected: LGPL-3.0-or-later, marked "best guess".
licstart-prose-gpl3.html
@licstart/@licend with no tag at all — just prose. This is the exact wording GNU's own librejs "free-your-javascript.html" page uses for its own inline script (also previously undetected). Expected: GPL-3.0-or-later, marked "best guess".
licstart-prose-gpl2.html ⚠️
Same prose-only convention, but the classic verbatim GPLv2-or-later notice. Known false positive: currently misclassified as GPL-3.0-or-later — see the page itself and the project README's "Limitations" section.
licstart-prose-lgpl3.html
Prose-only LGPLv3 notice. Expected: LGPL-3.0-or-later, marked "best guess".
licstart-prose-agpl3.html
Prose-only AGPLv3 notice. Expected: AGPL-3.0-or-later, marked "best guess".

Guessed — JavaScript License Web Labels table

web-labels-table.html
A #jslicense-labels1 table; the referenced script carries no license markers of its own at all. Expected: GPL-3.0-or-later, marked "best guess".

Baseline and known issue

unlabeled.html
No license declaration anywhere (inline and external). Expected: Missing for both.
edge-case-unlicensed-word.html ⚠️
Known false positive: an ordinary sentence using the word "unlicensed" (granting no rights, naming no license) gets misclassified as the Unlicense (public domain). Security-relevant since publicDomain is allowed by default — see the page itself and the project README.
